profile.summary: Strong arsenal of developing skills learned in a fast-paced and intense environment tailored to prepare for real-world situations. Proficient in front-end, middle and back end development with a focus on system integrations and APIs. Exceptional team player dedicated to continued learning in the tech field. Currently continuing education through Microsoft Learn and Trailhead. Spending free time with Unity and game design.

positions.title: Sr Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Kansas City, Missouri, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
Working with cloud technology, traditional and event driven architecture in Azure. Developing software and automation for .NET backend tech stack with a Next.js front end. Scrum methodologies using Jira and Confluence.

Database migration, development, and warehousing using Azure Managed SQL Instances, Azure SFTP, and Azure Data Factory. 

Lead for architecture and development, setting testing and documentation standards for the team. Worked on The Puzzle Society and GoComics site rebuilds.

positions.title: Software Developer II
positions.description: Worked and honed my skills with .NET Frameworks and Salesforce during my tenure with Grantham. Worked with authentication technologies including LDAP, WSO2,  SAML2, OAuth and IdentityServer3 & 4. Data design, manipulation, and integration with SQL, Oracle10/11/12, Web Services & REST APIs. Gained experience working with message queuing and building Core Windows Services. Worked with Agile and Waterfall Scrum methodologies, scoping and tasking for two-week sprints as well as entire projects. I have written from the bottom up many student-facing and process-automating applications as well as an identity server for authenticating the university's APIs. Helped to rework and standardize code moving from WebForms to MVC and then on to the .NET Core framework, as well as refactoring Soap services to REST APIs with a microservices approach. Helped to develop standards within the department, taking on a larger role in design, architecture, and interacting with the business to detail and fulfill requirements. Worked intensely with vendors to integrate third-party systems including Salesforce, Banner, Blackboard, PayPal, and Education Partners. Gained experience integrating and developing in Salesforce, having completed courses, several modules, and attending the Dreamforce '18 conference. In my third year I handled many team lead responsibilities including assisting with project management and business analyst duties, troubleshooting all aspects of our systems (ex front-end, integration, data, infrastructure), system administration, as well as continuously updating and improving our current systems. Began working to move our ecosystem into newer technology including Server-Side Blazor, .NET 5, and OpenAPI.

positions.title: Life Support Systems Technician
positions.description: Assisting with the building and assembling of parts and structures; Tasked with re-organizing, re-structuring, and improving start-to-finish processes; Reviewing and recommending changes for blueprints; Forming and utilizing  relationships with engineers and project planners to streamline processes and standards; Helping assemblers build first parts to new specifications for inspection and approval; Client list included Airbus and Boeing; Continued learning of ever changing industry standards.
positions.insights: Skills: Project Coordination · Quality Control · Microsoft Excel · Microsoft Word · Troubleshooting · Critical Thinking · Microsoft Office

positions.title: Life Support Systems Technician
positions.description: Assembling and testing life support systems for commercial and military aircraft; Worked with nitrogen and oxygen up to 7500psi in ISO clean rooms; Worked with brass fixtures, medical grade plastics, electrical assembly, soldering, dichloromethane, etc; Assisted with reviewing and redefining training and testing processes; Worked with engineers to revise blueprints and create tooling and testing fixtures; Received training for hazardous materials, FAA industry standards and paperwork, OSHA regulations and processes, cleared for work with military parts under ITAR, and gained security access for sensitive materials.
positions.insights: Skills: Project Coordination · Quality Control · Microsoft Excel · Microsoft Word · Troubleshooting · Critical Thinking · Microsoft Office

positions.title: Maintenance Mechanic
positions.description: Provided mechanical maintenance for heavy machinery including can/bottle fillers, can seamer, bottle capper, carbocooler, packaging/labeling equipment, and many others; Maintenance included tear downs, rebuilds, quality control, inspections, etc; Helped spearhead preventative maintenance initiatives, standards, and processes; Provided building maintenance including laying and replacing air and water lines, welding and fabrication to improve working conditions; Trained in production, operations, and laboratory processes to better understand the needs of the plant as well as emergency procedures, hazardous materials handling and response, and environmental policies and impact. 1 year contract position with Shasta Beverages Inc.
positions.insights: Skills: Project Coordination · Quality Control · Troubleshooting · Critical Thinking

positions.title: Cleaning & Sales Technician
positions.description: Was given a appointment list every morning and drove company vehicle to appointments, calling to confirm with each customer ahead of time; used oxi fresh products and cleaning unit to remove stains and do general cleanings on carpet, upholstery, and stairs; kept record of each appointment and inventory of products used; kept copies of receipts and bills; collected and turned in payments to our billing department; used customer service and sales skills including marketing, booking, product information and on sight sales; overall upsale percentage was 28%.
positions.insights: Skills: Quality Control · Microsoft Excel · Microsoft Word · Troubleshooting · Critical Thinking · Customer Service · Microsoft Office

positions.title: Crew Lead & Lab Technician
positions.description:
As crew lead: Supervised and trained new employees to run the packaging lines on the production floor, helping when necessary. Was in charge of paperwork regarding production and quality. Filled in for employees during breaks, handled materials with clamp truck, ran machine maintenance as needed.

As lab tech: Maintained quality control standards; utilized a number of measurement tools and equipment; Completed paperwork for testing, lab work, inventory, and maintenance; Acted as back up lab inspector and forklift driver; IT tech for all lines; Picked orders for shipping for warehouse when working double positions.
positions.insights: Skills: Project Coordination · Quality Control · Microsoft Excel · Troubleshooting · Critical Thinking

positions.title: Crew Lead
positions.description: Supervised a fabrication line that produced agriculture equipment with a focus on grain bins; Ran setups on presses, shears, and conveyors; Completed paperwork and inventory as well as quality control; Performed machine maintenance and filled in for the crew chief as needed.
positions.insights: Skills: Project Coordination · Quality Control · Troubleshooting · Critical Thinking

positions.description: Head of the maintenance department. Provided maintenance for entire property, including remodeling, repairs, general maintenance and upkeep. Used a wide skill set to perform required work and complete work orders. Position required communicating with all clientele including high profile preferred customers to assure the best quality service.
positions.insights: Skills: Project Coordination · Quality Control · Management · Troubleshooting · Critical Thinking · Customer Service

positions.title: Maintenance Engineer
positions.description: In short, general maintenance on several rentals properties and parks in and around the Warrensburg area. Would cover issues ranging from plumbing, electrical and HVAC to lawn care, grounds keeping, remodeling and construction. Definitely a jack-of-all-trades position. Was part-time and on call from 12/2010 - 05/2011.
positions.insights: Skills: Project Coordination · Quality Control · Troubleshooting · Critical Thinking · Customer Service

positions.title: CNC Machinist
positions.description: Ran an 80 ton press that punched out various parts and decks for mowers and ATV accessories. Programmed sequences and ran quality checks. Also floated to other positions including heavy saw, crane operator, metal shearer, brake press, MIG & TIG welding, grinders, mills, drill press, tool and die workshop, warehouse, inventory, and used forklift daily to move materials. Fabrication of lawnmower frames, mainly used 8-10 ton brake press, used a variety of equations to determine angle and degree of frame bend. Also took inventory of fabricated parts and quality control checks of same.

organizations.name: XBOX Ambassador
organizations.description:
As a Level 4 Xbox Ambassador, I am an active advocate and mentor within the Xbox gaming community. This role reflects my dedication to fostering inclusive gaming experiences, with a focus on improving accessibility for gamers of all backgrounds and abilities. I contribute to this mission by promoting accessibility initiatives, including the use of Xbox's adaptive devices, and actively raising awareness about the significance of inclusive game design.

In addition to participating in community discussions and providing technical support, I serve as a link between gamers and Microsoft, sharing feedback and insights that enhance the inclusivity and accessibility of the Xbox ecosystem. My Level 4 status underscores my expertise in Xbox products and my commitment to making gaming a more enjoyable and accessible experience for everyone.

Participated in many trips on several Missouri rivers to document erosion, wildlife, and water quality and levels. The teams collected trash and belongings left on the rivers, researched various wildlife populations and locations, documented any signs or erosion along river beds and cleared away any debris, and took test samples from river and recorded water levels.
